Kyocera devices covered

Made-up models for the parser tests: the markup follows the real page, the products do not exist.

Kyocera shall, as standard, support all in-scope devices for period of no less than three years from the point the relevant model was first made available in the UK.

These support periods are reviewed on a continual basis and extended where it is deemed prudent to do so, for the benefit of the consumer.

At no point shall the support periods advertised on this webpage be reduced, therefore not complying with the PSTI legislation.

Please refer to the in-scope models and applicable support periods outlined below:

ECOSYS Z9000dn

  • Date of first availability in the UK: Dec-16
  • End of support date: 31st December 2026

ECOSYS ZA9500x

  • Date of first availability in the UK: Jan-25
  • End of support date: 31st January 2028

ECOSYS ZA9500wx

  • Date of first availability in the UK: Jan 2025
  • End of support date: 30th September 2027

TASKalfa Z1

  • Date of first availability in the UK: Mar-22
  • End of support date: 31st December 2026

ECOSYS Z9999dn
